span.p:
Global State:
- Model weights replicated to each region's S3 (cross-region replication)
- User data lives in home region (DynamoDB Global Tables → eventual consistency)
- Rate limits enforced per-region, with global quota in Redis (cross-region)
- Cold-start model loading: 45 seconds per region (mitigated by pre-warming)
